name: gridbase
description: GridBase: a SQL workbench for Spark Thrift/Hive, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.

scripts.check:package-engine: node --check scripts/package-engine.js && node --check scripts/package-engine/smoke.js && node --check test/package-engine.test.js && python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path('scripts/package-engine/extract.py').read_text())"
scripts.test:desktop: node --test desktop/test/bridge.test.cjs desktop/test/shell.test.cjs desktop/test/lifecycle.test.cjs desktop/test/workflow.test.cjs test/local-session.test.js
scripts.check:desktop: node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check desktop/application.cjs && node --check desktop/shell.cjs && node --check desktop/host.cjs && node --check desktop/preload.cjs && node --check desktop/protocol.cjs && node --check desktop/startup.js && node --check desktop/test/desktop.e2e.cjs && node --check desktop/test/workflow-fixture.cjs && node --check public/runtime-transport.js && node --check public/local-session.js
